How did a civil engineer in the 1920s become an economic thinker, a constitutional analyst, and the pioneer of the Five-Year Plans? Aparajith Ramnath explains the "larger-than-life" journey of Sir M. Visvesvaraya. From the drinking water in Hyderabad to the founding of IISc and Mysore Sandal Soap, discover how he moved beyond bureaucratic ranks to provide the technocratic solutions that shaped modern India.
Thank you for watching our video!
